questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 25 · 第 1 题
questions.paper: 04 Geometry and Trigonometry 专项练习（重录）
questions.stem: In the figure, parallel lines q and t are intersected by lines r and s. If a = 43 and b = 122, what is the value of w?

figSpec.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 440 300' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><line x1='40' y1='150' x2='400' y2='150' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='60' y1='250' x2='420' y2='250' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='150' y1='40' x2='120' y2='285' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='260' y1='40' x2='330' y2='285' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><text x='132' y='142' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>q</text><text x='42' y='242' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>t</text><text x='146' y='34' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>r</text><text x='264' y='34' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>s</text><text x='196' y='96' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='14' fill='#162c46'>a°</text><text x='96' y='142' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='14' fill='#162c46'>b°</text><text x='318' y='236' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='14' fill='#162c46'>w°</text><text x='338' y='268' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='14' fill='#162c46'>w°</text></svg>

ledger.recompute: r、q、s 围成三角形：对顶角=43；b=122 的补角=58；第三角=180-43-58=79。q∥t，79° 与两个 w° 同旁互补：79+2w=180，w=101/2=50.5。官方答案册 Lines Ang. Tri. 36 复核一致。

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 25 · 第 3 题
questions.paper: 04 Geometry and Trigonometry 专项练习（重录）
questions.stem: In the figure shown, points Q, R, S, and T lie on line segment PV, and line segment RU intersects line segment SX at point W. The measure of angle SQX is 48°, the measure of angle SXQ is 86°, the measure of angle SWU is 85°, and the measure of angle VTU is 162°. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle TUR?

figSpec.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 440 300' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><line x1='30' y1='110' x2='410' y2='110' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='90' y1='110' x2='130' y2='210' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='250' y1='110' x2='130' y2='210' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='170' y1='110' x2='300' y2='240' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='250' y1='110' x2='300' y2='240' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='340' y1='110' x2='300' y2='240' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='212' cy='162' r='3' fill='#0f2a47'/><text x='24' y='104' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>P</text><text x='84' y='104' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>Q</text><text x='164' y='104' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>R</text><text x='244' y='104' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>S</text><text x='334' y='104' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>T</text><text x='414' y='104' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>V</text><text x='124' y='232' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>X</text><text x='206' y='158' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>W</text><text x='294' y='262' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>U</text></svg>

ledger.recompute: △SQX：∠QSX=180-48-86=46°。△SWU 中 ∠WSU=∠QSX=46°，∠SWU=85° → ∠SUW=180-85-46=49°；R、W、U 共线，∠TUR=∠SUW=49°。线上 quiz 答案 49 复核一致。

questions.hint: 三角形内角 74、23，第三角 83 与 x 对顶
questions.stem:
Intersecting lines r, s, and t are shown below.
What is the value of x?

figSpec.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 440 300' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><line x1='180' y1='40' x2='180' y2='270' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='60' y1='90' x2='380' y2='180' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='80' y1='220' x2='400' y2='200' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><text x='174' y='34' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>s</text><text x='386' y='176' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>r</text><text x='406' y='206' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='15' fill='#162c46'>t</text><text x='196' y='92' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='14' fill='#162c46'>106°</text><text x='296' y='196' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='14' fill='#162c46'>23°</text><text x='146' y='214' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif' font-size='14' fill='#162c46'>x°</text></svg>

ledger.recompute: 106° 的补角=74°；三角形内 74+23+第三角=180 → 第三角=83；x 与该角对顶相等，x=83。
